in_marathi.name: Amarjyoti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amarjyoti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amarjyoti is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Amar’ meaning immortal and ‘Jyoti’ meaning light. In Hindu mythology, the name is associated with the god Amarashiva, who represents immortality and enlightenment. The name evokes the idea of eternal light and the divine energy that illuminates our lives.
